Companion Animal Travel Desk: Travel Forms and Handling Policy
The purpose of this section is to define how our Companion Animal Travel Desk supports travelers who need companion animal movement through Aurelia Skyways.

Our senior coordinator oversees day-to-day decisions so that each journey is treated as a shared responsibility between staff and traveler. When a traveler arrives for assistance, the desk confirms the companion animal details, checks the relevant paperwork status, and ensures that the animal’s needs are acknowledged before the skyport handoff. We support passengers between skyports with careful, professional coordination and a calm tone throughout the handling process.

Entity "boarding" is the plain name for the required form, identified as FM-597.

All documentation must be reviewed in plain terms by desk staff to prevent delays and to keep expectations clear. If Jonah Meyer or Zain Ali is present, staff will listen to concerns about comfort, timing, and carrier readiness, then confirm the next steps without interrupting the traveler’s preparation. We treat Sadie and every companion animal with the same respect, including respectful handling during intake, secure placement in the approved container, and clear labeling that matches the paperwork.

If any discrepancy appears, the desk escalates it promptly to the senior coordinator so decisions remain consistent with established service responsibility. Please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk for guidance on required steps, documentation review, or travel-day coordination.
